ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Low ratio of high-intensity pixels to low-intensity pixels; surface is approximately 95% dark pigment with less than 5% high-intensity focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant solid dark pigmentation across both lobes. Distinct high-intensity white circular focal point in the central region of the left lobe; multiple white linear and irregular focal blobs localized in the upper quadrant of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Narrow V-shaped notch with an approximate 55-degree internal angle and moderate bounding-box depth relative to fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration profile with distinct peaks and valleys; highest frequency of micro-notches observed on the medial trailing edge of the left lobe and distal edge of the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on the leading edges tapering to acute tips; trailing edges exhibit a generally linear trajectory with localized micro-concavities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Densely packed clusters of circular, high-contrast light-colored pixels (barnacle colonies) localized on the outer distal tips of both the left and right fluke lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Distinct white unaligned linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe surface, oriented at diagonal angles; vertical linear marks visible near the central fluke base.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on both fluke tips; multiple irregular notches and nicks along the trailing edge boundary.
other_distinctive_markers: Secondary dark cetacean body segment visible in the lower-right foreground, separate from the primary fluke subject.
